source_text.Q-1058: CI main flake / defect, HIGH. Property 'any set of row writers is invisible after the boundary, and never rebuilds' in test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_pool_test.exs (property ~L1402, failing assertion ~L1430 `assert nonseed_rows(a.schema_name) == []`) fails on some ExUnit seeds. Regression of Q-1042 (PR #2397, edf3e614). Evidence: reproduced locally with `LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5499 MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_pool_test.exs --seed 193355` => 56/57; failing case after 2 successful runs: writers [:groups], via :test; nonseed_rows(a.schema_name) got [{"groups",1}] after recycle_pool! although pool_dirty_report(fx(:a)) said clean. Second occurrence on main 28fcc928, CI run 38235738863, shard 3/3 partition 11, seed 40898. H1 (isolation hole, the worse case): the pool leaves a row in an attached tenant after recycle, so a later test can see another test's writes. H2 (test defect): the property asserts on a.schema_name after a recycle that attached a different slot, so it checks the wrong schema. Acceptance: (1) root cause H1 or H2 with evidence from seeds 193355 and 40898 quoted; (2) if H1: SECURITY-REVIEWER note, the hole fixed, fix shown to hold on the failing sequences; (3) if H2: the assertion checks the schema that holds the writes, decision recorded with reasoning; (4) both seeds added as fixed regression cases of the property; (5) the property passes on the failing seeds and on a fresh sample of seeds across consecutive runs, real output quoted; (6) the property's claim (writers invisible after the boundary, no rebuild) is NOT weakened. Related, not duplicates: ISS-1054 (R1 current_database guard), ISS-1055 (R5 typing), ISS-1056 (V2 depth-2 FK). GH #2406, Q-1058.

MACHINE RULE: ONE BEAM at a time machine-wide; wrapper: L=/c/Users/tvolo/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/mixlock; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$L")"; until mkdir "$L" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 20; done; trap 'rmdir "$L" 2>/dev/null' EXIT; cd <dir> && LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5499 MIX_ENV=test <ONE mix invocation> 2>&1 .
